Name: Select Tool Power
Author: GrimatGaming
Description:
A mod that allows the player to select the power of the water can and hoe bypassing the need to charge it. This keeps the tool's max power restrictions. This is a successor of sorts to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2553]Crazy Wig's Tool Power Select[/url].

To change the power hold down the use button and page up (right trigger for controller) to raise power or page down (left trigger for controller) to lower power. Key mappings are also able to be changed using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url]

Some additional differences to Crazy Wig's Version -

[list]
[*]If using an iridium tool with reaching enchantment, 5x5 power is now available
[*]Game saves your option to your save file, so will remember the power setting on exiting the game.
[*]Keybinding changed to page up + page down and configurable in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url]
[/list]
Not tested with Multiplayer, but will review this when I get chance.
